items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: the one we work with, Tally Sherwood, he has the ability of making it sound as if you’re in the same room together.

ctx.x: There’s a really enjoyable video of one of his pieces and the recording and I think you’re in a room by yourself with headphones on. Does that take some getting used to?

Oh sure it does. Especially with a big band. You know you’re used to being in there and everybody feels everybody. You really want the band to feel what you’re doing but it’s just not practical anymore. Fortunately there’s lots of, we have a great engineer out here and there’s lots of great engineers, but the one we work with, Tally Sherwood, he has the ability of making it sound as if you’re in the same room together. That’s crucial.
